title: Notifications
description: In-app notices behind the bell. Built by deterministic rules from the customer's own data; never by the LLM.

NotificationKind.title: NotificationKind
NotificationKind.description: spending_change: everyday spending moved a lot week on week. challenge_ended: a challenge result is ready. challenge_suggestion: an invitation to try a challenge (sent rarely).

id.description: Stable: the same event always has the same id.

examples: Everyday spending is up this week

text.description: One or two plain sentences with the key numbers.

ask.description: The question sent to the coach when the customer opens the notice.
